methods.label: Add the leap day
methods.explanation: February has 1 extra day in a leap year. A common-year February has 28 days, so a leap-year February has \(28+1=29\) days. The answer is A.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 3 calendar knowledge and earlier mental addition of a one-digit number.
